segments.text: How to clone your partner's WhatsApp using only their phone number.
First, go to the website I'm sharing below and enter the number of the person you want to investigate.
In a few seconds, their photo will appear on the screen.
This confirms that the number exists and is active on WhatsApp.
After that, the system starts retrieving everything.
Recent conversations, sent photos, location and even deleted messages.
Now click on learn more and enter the number you want to investigate.
